species.real: In 1980 a real puma was caught in a trap near Cannich in the Highlands. It was so tame it was probably an escaped pet, and it lived out its days in a wildlife park.
species.name: Fen Tiger

dex.text: Nobody has ever got a clear photograph of it. It likes it that way. Seen at dusk in the sugar beet, big as a calf, and then not at all.
dex.fact: In 1982 people round Cottenham in the Fens reported a big striped cat; police searched with marksmen and a helicopter and found nothing. Fen Tigers was also the name for the fenmen who fought the drainers in the 1600s.
